title: Pan-Seared Kabanos with Skillet Crunch
description: A quick and easy breakfast recipe featuring crispy kabanos sausage and crunchy skillet topping.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add kabanos sausage and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer sausage to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add chopped skillet to the skillet and cook until crispy, stirring frequently.
Return sausage to the skillet and add zesty and russian to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional skillet if desired.
